items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: I was the first drummer in the Alumni All-Stars because Paul Parker needed a drummer and he asked me.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you ever have vocalists in the group by choice?
Yes we did. We did. Mike Parker, the son of Paul Parker, was our first trumpeter. And he had wife named Dottie.
